about_short_description.short_description: Enterpret analyzes customer feedback using AI and NLP, offering tailored insights for product growth.

product.name: Enterpret Customer Intelligence Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform that unifies customer signals from support, sales, surveys, reviews, social, CRM, and product usage data to generate contextual insights and support product, CX, support, sales, and market decisions.

product.name: Agent OS
product.description: An agentic workflow capability that monitors customer intelligence, initiates work proactively, creates artifacts, and coordinates actions without requiring a user to submit a request.

product.name: Enterpret MCP Server
product.description: An MCP-compatible server that makes Enterpret’s structured customer feedback and context available to AI assistants and internal tools for querying, analysis, and workflow execution.

product.name: Enterpret Onboarding and Support Services
product.description: Implementation and technical support services for configuring Enterpret, connecting feedback sources, defining customer feedback taxonomies, and maintaining service usage.
